summary: STAGING ONLY - not a published release. Generic OpenID Connect single sign-on (Google, Okta, Keycloak, Auth0, authentik, any OIDC provider) with SSO migration mode, CompDesk-managed identity-provider CA trust, private_key_jwt client authentication, and SMTP certificate options.
upgrade_notes: Rehearsal manifest for upgrade testing. Point a test installation at it with COMPDESK_UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL; never at production. Back up PostgreSQL, private attachments, uploaded branding, and the private configuration volume together before upgrading.
